decisions.thought:
Lead: 39% BRING: dragapult, 22% BRING: toxapex, 17% BRING: garchomp
Pick 2: 45% BRING: toxapex, 27% BRING: garchomp, 14% BRING: incineroar
Pick 3: 49% BRING: incineroar, 30% BRING: garchomp, 16% BRING: scizor

Opponent has bulky Toxapex, Incineroar, Scizor, Rotom-W, Garchomp, Dragapult. Bring Garchomp (rocks, EQ), Kingambit (beats Toxapex/Incineroar), Gholdengo (blocks status, beats Toxapex/Scizor). Watch their Dragapult speed; my Pult sash stays home.
51% MOVE: dracometeor, 14% MOVE: uturn, 11% SWITCH: incineroar

Their Dragapult may outspeed and hit me hard; rocks first turn while they likely U-turn or attack. Rocks chip Pult/Scizor/Incineroar. Then bring in Kingambit or Gholdengo to handle Pult. Keep Garchomp healthy for their Garchomp EQ later.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Pult likely faster; dragonclaw risky if it outspeeds. Stealth Rock is good—Pult may U-turn out. Rocks chip Pult/Scizor/Incineroar. Go rocks.

decisions.thought: Garchomp died turn 1 to Draco. Their Pult is fast and special, now -2 SpA. Send Gholdengo: takes Draco neutrally, threatens Shadowball, blocks status. Kingambit saved for Toxapex/Incineroar. Expect Pult to U-turn out or Draco again; watch for Scizor/Rotom-W later.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Pult has -2 SpA. Bring Gholdengo? Pult may Draco again or U-turn. Gholdengo resists Draco? No, Dragon neutral vs Steel/Ghost... Dragon hits Ghost neutral, Steel neutral — neutral. Kingambit resists Draco? Dark resists? No, Dragon not resisted by Dark. Kingambit takes neutral. Gholdengo immune to nothing relevant. Gholdengo better vs Pult (shadowball). Send Gholdengo.

decisions.thought: 50% MOVE: shadowball, 26% MOVE: phantomforce, 10% SWITCH: incineroar

Garchomp dead turn 1 to Draco. Gholdengo in vs -2 SpA Dragapult. Shadowball is SE and safe; Make It Rain drops my SpA. Pult may U-turn out—keep Gholdengo healthy vs Toxapex/Scizor. Kingambit saved for Incineroar/Toxapex. Watch their remaining two picks.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Shadowball hits Pult SE; Pult -2 SpA. Make It Rain also strong but drops SpA. Shadowball is safe.
